identity.name: Overseas Self-Winding

case.bezel: six-sided, derived from the Maltese cross

identity.one_liner: The 2016 Overseas generation — in-house caliber 5100, Geneva Seal, and tool-free strap, bracelet and rubber swaps.

narrative.story: The 4500V rebuilt the Overseas at SIHH 2016 around what the model had always lacked: a manufacture movement. Caliber 5100 brought a 22k gold rotor, 60 hours of reserve and the Geneva Seal, while the case kept the Maltese-cross-derived bezel and added the line's best trick — bracelet, leather and rubber all swap without tools, and every watch ships with all three. It became the third pillar of the integrated-steel trinity conversation alongside the Nautilus and Royal Oak, and the one you could actually buy. The 4520V generation phased it out from late 2023.
narrative.collector_notes: Confirm all three strap/bracelet options are present — replacing them through VC is slow and not cheap. The blue dial is the reference configuration; the silver and later dial colors trade behind it.
